summary: A coopered oak barrel with bulged staves, four iron hoops and a three-plank head, parameterised by height, radius, stave count, bulge and seed.
objective: At one metre the barrel reads as three tiers: a bulged silhouette with a proud chime, then individual staves and hoops, then rivets and per-stave hue.
intent_signals: add barrels to a village scene
example_prompts: Stack three barrels beside the tavern door.
I need a cask I can re-colour for a cellar scene.
not_for: Any claim about historical cooperage dimensions or capacity.
A container that actually holds a simulated fluid volume.

silhouette: bulged barrel profile: 34 cm at the belly falling to 27 cm at both heads
five iron hoops breaking the wooden surface by 1 cm each
stave ends standing 5 cm proud of the sunken head, the chime
medium: sixteen separate staves with a 6 percent gap between each pair
four stave courses whose joins are covered by the three middle hoops
a closed head sunk 5 cm below the stave ends, with two raised seam battens over it
fine: six rivet domes on every hoop, thirty in all, 2.4 cm across
1.2 cm chamfer on every stave edge, cut as geometry
per-stave hue jitter of 5 percent across the sixty-four stave segments
a bung boss on the top head, offset by a seeded amount from the centre

principles: A barrel is recognised by its bulge before anything else: a cylinder with hoops painted on reads as a bucket at every distance.
The hoops sit where the stave courses join, so the one feature that must be covered is covered by the feature the eye counts.
Variation belongs in the seed: sixteen identically toned staves read as a texture, not as wood.
implementation: Call create({ height, radius, staves, seed, bulge, gap }); the group is centred on its footprint with y = 0 at the ground.
Attach a tap, funnel or sack through the named sockets rather than by hand placing world coordinates.
Three instanced stave courses plus two instanced hoop-rivet fields keep the whole barrel at five draw calls.
observable_checks: Run scripts/kit-proof.py and count features in close.png: at least two from each detail-ladder band must be visible.
Two seeds differ visibly in stave tone while keeping the same silhouette.
The tap socket lands on the belly, not inside it: its z equals the radius parameter.

known_limits: Authored creative geometry. Nothing here measures a real cask, its capacity or its joinery.
The poly budget is the triangle count observed at default parameters; 24 staves costs about 4400 triangles.
The staves are four straight courses, not a continuous curve: at less than 30 cm from the surface the course joins are visible as facets.
creative_affordances: Any parameter may be pushed outside its stated range; the range is the band that was proved, not a limit.
Drop bulge to zero and raise the gap for a water butt, or re-colour the hoops brass for a spice cask.

defaults.rationale: Sized so the barrel reaches mid-thigh on a 1.7 m figure, which is what makes a row of them read as storage rather than as scenery bumps.
